# Abdus Sameer — Personal Platform & Research Publication
# https://abdussameer.com

## Who is Abdus Sameer?

Abdus Sameer is an interdisciplinary thinker, researcher, and builder.
He is curious about how the world works — connecting computer science, artificial intelligence,
semiconductors, economics, finance, business strategy, psychology, and philosophy to understand
complex systems and discover new ways of thinking about problems.

He is currently pursuing a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) and a Master of Arts in Economics (MA),
building on a completed Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA). He has professional experience in
sales, business development, and relationship management.

## Intellectual Identity

Central statement: Connecting ideas. Understanding systems. Solving problems.

He is interested in:
- Technology & Semiconductors (AI chips, EUV lithography, compute architectures)
- Economics & Finance (macroeconomics, valuation, competitive strategy)
- Business & Strategy (moats, capital allocation, founder dynamics)
- Science & Systems (complexity theory, emergence, physics)
- Philosophy & Human Behavior (epistemology, decision-making, cognitive science)

## Research Focus

Independent research on technology, semiconductors, and business strategy:
- ASML: EUV lithography and semiconductor supply chain monopoly analysis (in progress)
- NVIDIA: AI infrastructure and GPU compute dominance analysis (in progress)
- AI Infrastructure: Competitive landscape and investment thesis (upcoming)
